def transform(grid):
    # Fill the enclosed rectangle with alternating Chebyshev-distance bands
    # centered on the original 3 marker; preserve the marker itself.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 3]
    # The original frame is the outer 3 rectangle; identify inner region from its bounds.
    border = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 3]
    rmin, rmax = min(r for r,c in border), max(r for r,c in border)
    cmin, cmax = min(c for r,c in border), max(c for r,c in border)
    centers = [(r,c) for r,c in border if rmin < r < rmax and cmin < c < cmax]
    cr, cc = centers[0]
    for r in range(rmin+1, rmax):
        for c in range(cmin+1, cmax):
            d = max(abs(r-cr), abs(c-cc))
            if d:
                out[r][c] = 4 if d % 2 else 2
    return out
PY
